```zsh
# MASTER IRC-LIKE UI toggle
tmux -L IRC-SIMULATOR new -d -c $HOME
tmux display-message "SPLIT PANELS: %#{buffer2pane} [CURRENT] / %#{buffer1pane} [NEXT]"

# Add to .zshrc
export ZSH_UTILS=$HOME/TERMINAL_LAYOUT
mkdir -p $ZSH_UTILS

cat << EOF > $ZSH_UTILS/irc-emulat.rzsh
# BASIC IMITATION FRAMEWORK
export CHANNELS="general tech spam"
export PRIV_FILTER="messages 2/1y"
export NOTIFY_CMD="growlnotify --title 'IRC' -m 'New message'"

# EXPERIMENTAL
alias IIRC='tmux split-window -v "tail -f /dev/tty | read && vhats post"'
export PS1="\[\033[31m\]\u@\h \[\033[32m\]\w \[\033[37m\]\\ \$\[\033[0m\] "
EOF

. $ZSH_UTILS/irc-emulat.rzsh

# Final safety check
ctree difference $HOME .custom-irc-ui | wipe dents
echo "ALERT: UI MODS REVOKED. RESTORE MASTER STANCE."
```
